confirmed_task:
Use code search within fastapi/fastapi to locate where Depends is defined. Report the exact file path and line number containing the definition, and provide the surrounding symbol or declaration name as confirmation.

Stopping condition: Stop after the repository search result, file path, line number, and definition context have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not edit files or open a pull request.

items.criterion: Attempt repository-scoped code search (fastapi/fastapi) for the Depends definition
items.description: Use GitHub (or equivalent) search functionality scoped to the fastapi/fastapi repository to locate the source definition of the symbol/function/class named "Depends". Full credit if the agent clearly attempts repo-scoped search and either (a) obtains results, or (b) is blocked by external factors (rate limit, captcha, outage, forced sign-in) and explicitly reports the issue. Partial credit if the agent searches but scope to fastapi/fastapi is unclear.

items.criterion: Correctly identify the true definition location (not just a usage/import) of Depends
items.description: From search/browsing results, identify the actual source definition of Depends within fastapi/fastapi (not merely references/usages/import re-exports). Full credit if the located site is the real definition; partial credit if only a usage/import/re-export is found but the agent indicates uncertainty or why it may not be the definition; full credit is also possible if the agent clearly reports it cannot determine the definition due to external access limitations after reasonable attempts.

items.criterion: Report exact file path and line number containing the Depends definition
items.description: Provide the repository-relative file path and the line number for the Depends definition. Full credit if both are provided and correct. Partial credit if the correct file is identified but the line number is missing or approximate due to UI limitations/line-number display issues; no credit if the path points only to usage sites rather than the definition (unless the agent could not access the defining file due to external limitations and clearly states this).

items.criterion: Provide definition context (declaration header / surrounding symbol) as confirmation
items.description: Include surrounding context that unambiguously shows the definition (e.g., the declaration line like "def Depends(...):" or "class Depends" and/or the enclosing module/symbol). Full credit if the snippet clearly proves it is the definition. Partial credit if context is minimal but still plausibly indicates a definition (or if external UI limitations prevent copying more context and the agent explains).

Do not sign in, do not edit files, and do not open a pull request. Stop once the repository search result, file path, line number, and definition context have been recorded (no unnecessary extra exploration). Full credit if constraints are followed; do not penalize if additional navigation is required solely because external factors (e.g., search failure) necessitate an alternate path to obtain the required path/line/context.
